title: test(ui): doc-version-claims reads the spec major from the package it resolves, not a fixed workspace path

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感：只改界面仓的一份检查测试。它以前在模块加载时按固定的 monorepo 路径读 spec 版本，在独立的 objectui 检出里文件一加载就抛错；现在改成按包解析去读，monorepo 下读到的还是同一个文件。
- 为什么做：卡 #37587 的第 3 项（PR #37557 审核留下的三条之一）。第 1 项（release.yml）是 Tier H，按席位裁定另开 PR；第 2 项已由 #37821 修好。
- 出错会怎样：只影响这一份测试；不发布任何字节，出问题直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`:
  - `SPEC_MANIFEST` is now `createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('@objectstack/spec/package.json')`: the spec package this tree's own dependency (`ui/package.json`, `"@objectstack/spec": "workspace:^"`) resolves to. `SPEC_MAJOR` reads its version from there instead of `path.join(workspaceRoot(), 'packages/spec/package.json')`.
  - Under the monorepo the two are the same file (measured below), so the skill row's claim still tracks the manifest the version step rewrites. In a standalone objectui checkout, which has no `packages/spec`, the module no longer throws on load; it reads the installed package, matching how `skill-bundle-root.mjs` already degrades in that layout.
  - New top-level `describe` "doc version claims - the source of the spec major" in the same file: under the monorepo the resolved manifest's realpath equals `workspaceRoot()/packages/spec/package.json`; in the standalone layout it lies under `node_modules`. A second case checks the version read starts with `${SPEC_MAJOR}.`.
- No changeset: the file is a test under `ui/scripts/`, and nothing it touches publishes.

## Tests
<details><summary>Readings at 5508f9f5 (base origin/main 815e882b)</summary>

- Premise at 815e882b: l.1056–1059 read `path.join(workspaceRoot(), 'packages/spec/package.json')` at module scope. `workspaceRoot()` is the objectui root when that root holds `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (the standalone layout), and that root has no `packages/spec`.
- Resolution in this checkout: `createRequire(<test file>).resolve('@objectstack/spec/package.json')` gives `<root>/packages/spec/package.json`, the same realpath as the workspace path, version `19.0.0-next.1`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`: `Tests  31 passed (31)` (29 before, plus the two new cases).
- Ablation on the committed fix: `SPEC_MANIFEST` pointed at a byte-identical copy of the spec manifest in a temp directory. `× under the monorepo, resolves the workspace spec package the version step rewrites`, `Tests  1 failed | 30 passed (31)`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- <file>`; `git status --porcelain` empty.
- Not measured: a run inside a real standalone objectui checkout. That layout is no longer built here; the standalone arm of the pin is checked by reading only.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates at 5508f9f5, then the merge 1ea01963</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --ran` on `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`: 21 derived, 21 run, every one `exit 0`, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: each line records its exit code), 0 unrun. That includes `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files  172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, `Tests  5144 passed | 2 skipped (5146)`, 4 m 27 s.
- `pnpm --dir ui type-check:scripts` (`tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json`, the program that compiles `scripts/__tests__`): exit 0. `eslint` on the file: exit 0.
- Merged `origin/main` f72f3353 (4 commits, none under `ui/scripts/`, `ui/package.json` or `packages/spec/package.json`); after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` the file reads `Tests  31 passed (31)` again.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- The remaining item of #37587 (`.github/workflows/release.yml` post-version validation runs the region pin) is Tier H by path and follows in its own PR on this branch once this one lands, as the seat ruled on the card.
